summary: Keeps 5 Sunder Armor stacks on the boss for a raid with no warrior tank. The raid's Sunder Armor is off.
rotation: Pre-pull: Battle Stance, then Charge (15 Rage)

Sunder Armor on duty for the raid: 5 stacks from the pull (7.5s of GCDs), before anything but the opening cooldowns, then refreshed in its last 3s, unless it lasts the fight. The raid's Sunder Armor is off
With 25s left, if Recklessness is ready and Rage is under 25, swap to Berserker Stance. Swap back after Recklessness
Recklessness in the last 25s. Racials on cooldown, but Elune's Light never during Recklessness or the 15s before it
Mighty Rage Potion at the pull, the second in the last 15s. Bloodrage under 20 Rage
Reckless Swings on cooldown. It is off the GCD, and the next 4 swings give 5 more Rage each
Slam at 20+ Rage outside execute (10s cooldown with Improved Slam), ahead of Mortal Strike
Overpower at 5+ Rage after a dodge or Bloodthrill
Keep Rend up outside execute. Then Execute
Heroic Strike at 90+ Rage and Hamstring filler at 10+, both outside execute
caveats: The duty costs 38.3 DPS at 180s against the same build without it (970.4 against 1008.7, 20,000 iterations, seed 1). Part of it is the ramp: the warrior's own hits meet fewer stacks for the first 7.5s, where the raid's Sunder was full at once.
Assumed: white hits give Rage by weapon speed, at the level 30 rate even at level 60.
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks, so Heroic Strike stops at rank VIII, and the raid's Battle Shout at VI, Strength of Earth at IV and Grace of Air at II.
Assumed: the crit Rage bonus is for white hits only. Heroic Strike can trigger Unbridled Wrath.
Only one +2% crit elixir. A second (Grizzly) would add 10.9 DPS.
Battlegear of Glory 4-piece isn't counted. It would add 8.4 DPS vs Humanoids.
Booming Voice (5/5) does nothing, because the raid already has Battle Shout
Arms in Berserker Stance with Whirlwind is 10% behind.
Rage from taking raid damage (2 hits a minute, about 9 Rage each) is an estimate.
notes: Request from mksettings with the same arguments as warrior__arms except -apl level60_arms_sunder, then the raid's sunderArmor removed (the duty warrior's Sunder is the only one, as for a raid with no warrior tank). Made as a hand edit of the base request, which is the same. A raid sim variant (docs/raid_sim.md, M1b), in the DPS report since 2026-10-30.
